# Nour Mamdouh

> Nour Mamdouh is a Full Stack Engineer at Digital Experts Marketing in Giza, Egypt. He designs the interface, then writes the Next.js, React, and Supabase that ship it. He studies Information Technology at New Cairo Technological University.

This file is a short, factual index of the public portfolio. The page itself is the source.

## Work

- ClientRoute: a freelancer and client operating system for clients, projects, tasks, invoices, and a client portal. Live site: https://clientroute.space
- NCTU Gates: university event registration, payment review, QR tickets, and gate check-in. The check-in rules live in the database. Live site: https://uni-six-delta.vercel.app
- Digital Experts Marketing: the company website, built with Next.js and Supabase. https://digitalexperts.ae/en
- Other shipped work on the portfolio includes Opera (trip booking), Martex Store, Elearn, Prime Care, Tagom CRM, Covering, and 3zbawyh POS.

## Experience

- Full Stack Engineer at Digital Experts Marketing, current. Built the company website with Next.js and Supabase.

- Instructor at KidZania Egypt, June 2025 to September 2025.
